# Pre-generation public fixtures

Extracted from the archived `dev/optimization-v51/tasks.json` and the
v54/v55/v56 batch files. The committed fixtures contain only public task text
and routing identities:

- `tasks.json`: `case_id`, `prompt`, `interface`
- `batch-v*.json`: `card_id`, `route_case_id`

Reference implementations, target/adjacent variants, suites, hashes, hosts and
all other development fields remain in
`dev/archives/20261029-rag-rc46/` outside this repository.
